correctness.rationale: At vertex i, indegree=outdegree=2 is exactly a_i+b_i=a_(i-1)+b_(i-2). The eight-state closed-walk transfer matrix with states (a_(i-1),b_(i-2),b_(i-1)) has four invariant classes (one zero, one full, two three-state) with nontrivial characteristic polynomials λ(λ²-uλ-v) and λ(λ²-vλ-u²v). The power-sum recurrence of each quadratic gives the exact Lucas/binomial coefficient polynomial; on odd n>=5 all n+3 exponent pairs are disjoint. Independently enumerated all 2^(2n) direction assignments at n=5 and n=7 and matched each exact bivariate coefficient (24 and 60 total orientations and respectively 8 and 10 winding pairs). Source independent transfer script checks n5..15. The all-n conclusion follows from transfer-matrix block algebra, not finite extrapolation.
